bootstrap.method: paired percentile bootstrap over tasks; same index draw np.random.default_rng(seed).integers(0,n,(B,n)) as the paper; pointwise, post hoc

token_convention:
Shared read-only loaders for section4_fixes. Every file read is sha256-pinned in PINS.

Token conventions are those of the verified prior scripts (oral_route_decision_20260917/scripts/flawhunt/recompute.py,
verify_flawhunt/v.py) and reproduce audit.json required_witness_comparison to every digit:
  sol   (codex engine): output = output_tokens_bound_model; uncached = input_tokens - cached_input_tokens; cache = cached_input_tokens
  gemini (agy engine):  output = output_tokens_bound_model; uncached = input_tokens; cache = cache_read_tokens
  opus_task1:           runs/cost_experiment/telemetry.jsonl fields output, input_uncached, input_cache_read (per-line sums, provisional)
  full = output + uncached + cache ; input_only = uncached + cache
Tool use ('extra execution') = usage.extra_exec_count > 0, i.e. shell commands / tool executions beyond the single
print-only read of the input file, as counted by the harness and used by flawhunt/noexec.py. Not recorded for opus_task1.
No model, API or Slurm call is made anywhere in this package.

tier_definitions.kept43: crosswalk current_release_status == RETAINED and witness_action == KEPT
tier_definitions.invalidated13: crosswalk blockers contain SEMANTIC_EXCLUDED (10) or RETAINED with witness_action REPLACED_INVALID (3)
tier_definitions.never_audited29: crosswalk current_release_status == NOT_IN_425_LEDGER (not tabulated; nothing is known about these references)

nesting_checks: exact15 < whole22 < supported42 <= kept43 < ledger71 < all100; invalidated13, unresolved15, kept43 partition ledger71
limitations: Tiers are selected subsets defined by an automated audit and semantic binding; none is a random sample, and no tier is new human approval.
Only the tiers inside supported42 have references the audit found consistent with the source text; kept43 is release status, not source fidelity.
Grades are the frozen September model-grader grades; nothing was regraded. A CAUGHT_MATCHING grade on an invalidated reference is agreement with a reference the audit rejected.
Full tokens = output + uncached input + cache-read input on accepted solver attempts only; Opus counts are per-transcript-line sums and provisional.
Intervals are pointwise paired percentile bootstraps (20000 resamples, seed 20260917), not equivalence tests; small tiers have wide intervals.
